source.name: LIV Golf: Swannies Golf announced as official on-course apparel partner of RangeGoats GC
source.quote: RangeGoats Golf Club today announced a team partnership deal with Swannies Golf.
source.note: Article announces the multi-year deal ahead of the February 2025 season; the page shows only '20 months ago', no exact date. The RangeGoats team page (livgolf.com/rangegoats-gc, opened 2026-10-03) still lists Swannies as a partner, by logo link.

source.name: LIV Golf: Rangegoats GC launches community impact program 'Goats Give Back'
source.quote: RangeGoats GC today announced the launch of its community impact program, Goats Give Back, in cooperation with Convoy of Hope.
source.note: The page shows only '26 months ago', no exact date. The RangeGoats team page (livgolf.com/rangegoats-gc, opened 2026-10-03) still lists Convoy of Hope as a partner, by logo link.

source.name: LIV Golf: RangeGoats Golf Club announces purpose-led sponsorship with Freddy's Frozen Custard & Steakburgers for 2026 Season
source.quote: RangeGoats Golf Club of the LIV Golf League has announced a new and expanded sponsorship with Freddy’s Frozen Custard & Steakburgers
source.note: The page shows only '8 months ago', no exact date; the article announces the 2026 deal. Freddy's becomes official QSR partner with its logo on the golf bags of all four players throughout 2026. The team page (livgolf.com/rangegoats-gc, opened 2026-10-03) still lists Freddy's as a partner.

source.name: LIV Golf - RangeGoats GC team page
source.note: Partner logo link to neweracap.com shown on the team page; the page shows the four team partners as logo images with no text list, so nothing can be quoted. Opened 2026-10-03: still exactly the four partners listed here (Swannies, Convoy of Hope, Freddy's, New Era). New Era is also Official Cap of LIV Golf league-wide (livgolf.com/partners).

summary: Team partners 2026: Swannies (official on-course apparel), Convoy of Hope (Goats Give Back impact partner), Freddy's (official QSR partner), New Era (official cap). Captain: Bubba Watson.
